facts.business: Vardhan Capital and Finance Limited is a non-banking financial company (NBFC) primarily engaged in investment activities and granting loans and advances to related parties.

auditor.name: M/s JMT & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on: 1) Related Party Loans and Advances of Rs. 8.54 crore with uncertainty on recoverability and non-recognition of interest/impairment; 2) Outstanding undisputed statutory dues of Rs. 2.23 crore (primarily TDS) unpaid for over 6 months; 3) Pending NBFC regulatory filings and returns with RBI.

key_risks: Recoverability of related party loans (Rs. 8.54 crore) and non-recognition of impairment/ECL
Unpaid statutory dues (Rs. 2.23 crore) with potential interest/penalty
facts.related_party_note: As at 31 March 2026, the Company has outstanding loans and advances aggregating approximately Rs. 8.54 crore granted to related parties (group concerns). Management describes these as strategic long-term exposures linked to underlying projects facing regulatory/operational delays. Interest accrual discontinued; no impairment/ECL recognized as settlement plan is under finalization. Recoverability subject to significant uncertainty.
